description: Memory for the draw packets of each frame: two zeroed buffers of size_bytes, one per display buffer, each followed by canary_bytes of canary_value that are checked after every frame to catch an overrun. Whole-town drawing submits 60 or more map chunks at once, so 16 MB fits about 400 chunks; normal play stays under 2 MB. stats_window_frames and headroom_log_percent control the usage log. A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.
